name: Blanche Leclerc
original_name: ブランシュ・ルクレール
source: An honorable and hardworking female knight. Due to her talent and hard work, Blanche was quickly admitted by [url=/c96499]Lilfynia Haidopair[/url] to the elite ranks of the Knights of Haidopair. Blanche admires Lilfynia greatly and strives to become more like her. However, in her longing for Lilfynia she becomes so stubborn that she sometimes struggles to be honest.
